brand.app_title: Ops Council — Multi-Agent Cloud Operations Intelligence

orchestrator.name: Orchestrator
orchestrator.role: Routes each request to the right specialists, connects their findings, and delivers one unified, transparent recommendation.

cost_sentinel.name: Cost Analyst
cost_sentinel.role: Finds waste, tracks burn rate, and recommends rightsizing — always shows the math behind every recommendation.

standards_architect.name: Standards Architect
standards_architect.role: Explains why infrastructure is configured the way it is, validates changes against organizational standards, and flags what a change would break.

diagnostics_sre.name: Diagnostics Specialist
diagnostics_sre.role: Root-cause analysis from Azure telemetry — timeline, symptoms, root cause, and remediation, without needing elevated access.

scout.name: Monitoring Scout
scout.role: Continuously scans for anomalies, health degradation, and security drift, and raises short, actionable alerts.

compliance_inspector.name: Compliance Auditor
compliance_inspector.role: Classifies Azure Policy violations as policy bugs, misconfigurations, documented exemptions, or workaround abuse, and recommends the right fix for each.
